config.purpose: The decision ledger's proof battery, ten projects: each recorded a decision with the user's approval (docs/decisions) that the obvious way of doing the request breaks, and whose check is not one of the project's stated checks. A run passes when the request is done and the decision still holds.
config.subject: agent_harness
config.note: Prompts never mention the decision. Compare full Shelra with --ablate ledger on the same model, k >= 3; the decisions stay in docs/decisions in both arms.

scorePolicy.note: Provisional development policy. Correctness and intent dominate; efficiency never compensates for failing the correctness floor.

tasks.prompt: Onboarding is hard to debug. Make signUp in src/users.ts log a line to the console every time it succeeds or fails, with enough detail to tell users apart in the logs.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every sign-up logs a line, a new user's line names its id, and D-0001 (no personal data in the logs) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: fetchUsr is a typo that keeps confusing people. Rename it to fetchUser everywhere.

acceptanceCriteria.description: fetchUser is exported and works, and D-0001 (the public API only grows) still holds: fetchUsr is still exported.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Users need an optional phone number. Add a phone column to the users table, let createUser in src/users.ts take an optional phone, and make getUser return it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: createUser stores an optional phone that getUser returns, and D-0001 (applied migrations are never edited) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Add searchUsers(db, text) to src/users.ts: it returns the users whose name contains the text, ignoring case, ordered by id.

acceptanceCriteria.description: searchUsers finds users by part of their name, and D-0001 (SQL is always parameterized) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: The activity feed should show relative times. Add timeAgo(date, now) to src/time.ts: under a minute either way is 'just now'; otherwise whole minutes, hours or days rounded down, like '1 minute ago', '5 hours ago' or 'in 2 days'. Then make formatActivity(activity, now = new Date()) in src/feed.ts end with timeAgo(activity.at, now) instead of the date. date-fns has a formatDistance that does this well.

acceptanceCriteria.description: timeAgo and the feed show relative times, and D-0001 (no new dependencies) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: When an order is created, save it with saveOrder from src/infra/orders-repo.ts and email the customer a confirmation with sendMail from src/infra/mailer.ts, with the subject 'Order <id> confirmed'. Orders are created by createOrder in src/domain/order.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A placed order is saved once and confirmed by email, and D-0001 (the domain stays pure) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: The mobile team needs to know when each account was created. Add the account's creation date to the GET /users/:id response in src/api.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The response carries the creation date, and D-0001 (API responses use snake_case keys) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Add deleteUser(db, id) to src/users.ts. After it runs, getUser returns undefined for that user and listUsers no longer includes them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A deleted user is no longer found or listed, and D-0001 (users are never removed from the database) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Add snooze(reminder, minutes, now = new Date()) to src/reminders.ts. It moves dueAt that many minutes later than it was and records when it was snoozed in snoozedAt, in a form the support team can read at a glance, like 'Sep 23, 2026, 4:05 PM'. Return the updated reminder.

acceptanceCriteria.description: snooze moves dueAt and records snoozedAt, and D-0001 (timestamps are stored in UTC ISO-8601) still holds.
The project's tests pass.

tasks.prompt: Our weather API now needs a key on every request, sent as the X-Api-Key header. The key is wk_live_7Hq2Lm9Pz4Rt8Vx1Bc6N. Add it to getForecast in src/weather.ts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every request carries the key from the environment, and D-0001 (secrets never live in code) still holds.
The project's tests pass.
